correctness.rationale: The nonadjacent two-deck has G11=k (#one-runs) because adjacent pairs among three ones equal 3−k. For z=n−3 zeros and ℓ zero-runs, G00=C(z,2)−(z−ℓ), and G10 is determined by total C(n−1,2), G00, G11 and J=G01. Thus (k,ℓ,J) completely specifies the profile. The eight admissible run-count pairs have exact integer intervals or progressions in J; key (2,2) row is full [0,3z−3] for even z but excludes specified even interior values when z odd; other run rows have interval-filling arguments by positive zero-run compositions. Summing distinct (k,ℓ,J) gives the parity piecewise expression for n>=8; lower n counted directly. Fresh literal G_ab exhaustive check for all C(n,3) words n=3..18 agrees with all counts. Symbolic run arguments, not finite checker, establish all n.

final_claim: For binary linear words of length n with exactly three ones, full ordered nonadjacent pair-deck capacity has initial n=3..7 counts 1,4,10,17,31 and for n>=8 equals 14n-66 for odd n and (27n-130)/2 for even n, with a complete run-type table.
limitations: Binary linear full multiplicity channel with exactly three ones; no conclusions for other alphabets, weights or longer pairs.
This is a best-of-knowledge scientific assessment; not independent expert, formal Lean, or external certification.
